sentences.en: The tornado left a trail of destruction in its wake.
sentences.zh: 1. 这场龙卷风在其经过的地方留下了一条破坏的痕迹。

sentences.en: Running the Inca Trail near Machu Picchu can be arduous.
sentences.zh: 2. 在马丘比丘附近跑印加古道可能会非常艰难。

sentences.en: Detective Dan Anderson stayed on the trail like a bloodhound.
